message: 見えざる者
Forget the exam blues and put everything we've got into the Holy Night Festival.
First, we need to prepare thoroughly. To do that, I should ask Helena-san for her opinion.
Helena-san's cooperation was the foundation that made KiraFes a success.
Whenever we were about to overstep the Student Council's bounds and get carried away, she immediately pointed it out.
I want to ask her to be the voice of reason for the Holy Night Festival, too.

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Helena is in the office.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, if it isn't Synn-dono.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes!? S-Shio-chan... Are you quitting the academy? How could something like that--」

name: Shio
message: 「Wha!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, that's just cruel.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. No matter how 'a little questionable' Asukai-san's grades may be, jumping straight to expulsion just because she is in the chairwoman's office is quite uncalled for.」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What do you mean by 'a little questionable'?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Her class rank is two hundred--」

name: Shio
message: 「Waaah, waaaaah, waaaaaaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shio-chan, calm down. If you barely missed the mark this time, you can just aim higher on the next test.」

name: Shio
message: 「Um... I am hopeless every single time, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Back me up here!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Asukai-san, before that, please back up Helena and myself.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oops, that is right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, what are you doing?」

name: Shio
message: 「As a shrine maiden of the Asukai, I am merely driving out that wretched Kokkuri.」

name: Synn
message: 「K-Kokkuri-san!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, Helena started it half as a joke, but... even after giving its fortune, it has lingered here and refuses to leave.」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you're so mean~ You were having fun asking it all sorts of questions too, Melilot.」
Looking closely, a sheet of paper with the Japanese syllabary, numbers, and "Yes" and "No" written on it is spread out on the director's desk.
It's a game my occult-loving classmates used to play all the time when we were kids.

name: Shio
message: 「I sensed a strange presence drifting from the director's office, so I came to investigate, and sure enough...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Didn't you actually just get a bad test score and run away to escape Ms. Cristelis's thunderous wrath?」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, is Kokkuri-san actually in this room? I don't see anything at all.」

name: Shio
message: 「Why, it is right over there, you know?」
Shio-chan points toward the top of the shelf stocked with alcohol.
...There's nothing there but the wall.

name: Helena
message: 「I can't see anything either. If you're really here, Kokkuri-san, please answer our questions a little more seriously.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Almost all of the divinations were just cheap attempts at getting laughs...」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, when we asked about the names of our future husbands or how many babies we'd have--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Apparently, I am going to give birth to 3,750 children.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you pop out triplets every ten months and ten days, factoring in the margin of error, you'll hit roughly that number in about a thousand years.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No thank you!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, Kokkuri-san quite often misses the mark on purpose, you see?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. Like a sly old badger, it is a cunning entity that leaves behind words imbued with spiritual power meant to sow doubt in people's minds.」

name: Shio
message: 「Precisely. It is not some arrogant fool that would flaunt its power by giving an oracle for every little thing it is asked.」
Huh? Setting aside Shio-chan, who's a shrine maiden, doesn't it sound like Melilot-san actually knows a lot about Kokkuri-san too?

name: Helena
message: 「My, how remarkably thoughtful. So in other words, you're saying...」

name: Helena
message: 「Kokkuri-san glosses over the things we don't need to know, and only reveals the things we ought to cherish and remember far into the future...」

name: Shio
message: 「Just so! As expected of a heroine, you are quite quick on the uptake.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, when I asked for the name of my lifelong friend, the oracle returned 'Melilot'♪」

name: Synn
message: 「That's definitely the right answer, no doubt about it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot asked the exact same question, too, yet her oracle didn't say 'Helena'.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm, maybe I phrased the question poorly?」

name: Synn
message: 「To Melilot, you aren't just a friend, Helena--you're her best friend. At least, that's how I see it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Y-Yes! That's right, Helena!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? What a sweet thing to say. By the way, the oracle Melilot asked for is written down on that piece of paper--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hyaa!」
Melilot dives onto the desk... right on top of the paper with the notes written on it.
She's usually so fearless and composed, so what kind of answer could possibly be written there?

name: Melilot
message: 「Haa, haa, haa... Destroying the evidence.」

name: Shio
message: 「Good grief, the Kokkuri is looking over here and laughing, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Because Helena-dono and Melilot-dono possess mature minds, no serious harm has come of this, however...」

name: Shio
message: 「I cannot say I approve. For the chairwoman and the librarian to summon such a spirit.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh? ...Hehe.」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-What was that?! Gah, I need no telling from you! Begone at once!」

name: Shio
message: 「Phew, pheww. ...It has finally left.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio? Why did you get angry?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As it was leaving, it teased her.」

name: Melilot
message: 「'Hey now, Asukai, don't let your guard down just because you're an exorcist shrine maiden? Demons and spirits are quite different, you know?'」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. Word for word, that was the Kokkuri's parting remark.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You could see it too, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I'm just constitutionally inclined that way.」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, I have finished covering for you two. Next is Synn-dono! Please cover for my test scores!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, the results have already been posted, what do you expect me to do? More importantly, Helena, I wanted to talk to you about the Holy Night Festival--」

name: Shio
message: 「At this rate, my elder sister will scold me severely! Please save me!」
With great effort, I manage to calm Shio down.
The matter was settled with Melilot agreeing to lend her some recommended reference books.
Just like during the KiraFes, Helena advised me to do what I want with both freedom and responsibility.
